build.name: pip install the acquired source (+ pinned deps)
build.cmd: pip install -q pandas . 2>&1 | grep -v -i 'notice\|warning' | tail -2; python -c 'import sys; print(sys.version.split()[0])'

runs.name: minvol (Techne harness, oracle-backed; same-container install + run)
runs.cmd: pip install -q pandas . 2>&1 | grep -v -i 'notice\|warning' | tail -2 >/dev/null; python $HARNESS/minvol.py

notes: Oracle: feasibility (weights sum to 1, long-only) and dominance (the min-volatility portfolio's variance is below the equal-weight variance) on the bundled 20-asset price history. Profitability is not scored.
